news.title: Man killed in Buford Highway shooting over alleged affair
news.summary: A personal dispute outside a Buford Highway eatery erupted into deadly gunfire early Sunday, leaving a man dead and two restaurant patrons hurt by shattered glass, Doraville police said.

news.title: Man surrenders after teen killed outside Jonesboro apartments
news.summary: A 26-year-old man surrendered to Clayton County police Sunday in connection with the fatal shooting of 16-year-old Jayden Miller outside an apartment complex in Jonesboro.

news.title: Person stabbed in southwest Atlanta; Currently in stable condition
1 dead, 2 injured after fire at DeKalb County home, officials say
news.summary: One person is dead, and two others are injured after a heavy fire tore through a three-story home on Lake Drive in DeKalb County on Saturday night, according to fire officials.
